description: Search Junely’s catalog of Colorado summer camps and after-school programs, checked against each provider’s own page. Filter by child age, month, region, category, price, and open availability. Freshness is per row, not daily: every result starts from its captured extraction date (can be weeks old); live_verified additionally means Junely re-checked that program’s own page today for after-school listings, or confirmed plausible status/dates at last capture for camp listings — it is not proof every listing was checked today.

category.description: Category, e.g. STEM, Sports, Arts, Outdoors, Academic

month.description: Month the program should run, e.g. "July" or "7"

open_only.description: Only programs currently open for registration (default false)

region.description: Colorado region or city, e.g. "Denver", "Boulder", "Colorado Springs"

name: search_programs
title: Search Colorado kids’ camps & after-school programs
